Wildheart is a year-round circle for women who are ready to stop holding it all together. Every other week you gather with the same women to move, breathe, make noise, laugh and feel at home in your body. Come once and see what wakes up.
Wildheart is for women 25 to 55 who look capable from the outside and feel contained, tired or quietly disconnected from their own bodies and desires.
Wildheart is practice and community, not therapy or crisis care. Every host has a written referral route for a woman who needs more than the circle can give.

Wildheart is the women's branch of Hearth, a year-round circle and the sister to Hearts on Fire. It teaches women to come back into their bodies and let what is inside move out: in movement, voice, pleasure, play and presence. It is a place to take up space without apology.
